tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List or search the workspace's contacts. Optional full-text query `q`.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact. Provide at least one of: firstName, lastName, company, phone, email.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Update a contact's name, company, phone, or email by contactId. Only provided fields change.

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.description: Permanently delete a contact by contactId. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List recent conversations. Optional `status` filter (open|done).

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Get a conversation's full message thread by id.

tools.name: set_conversation_status
tools.description: Mark a conversation open or done by conversationId.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search message bodies, voicemail transcripts, and call notes across every conversation. Returns newest matches first with their conversation ids.

tools.name: workspace_summary
tools.description: Snapshot of the workspace: contact count, open/done conversation counts, unread total, active numbers, and 7-day message/call volume. Call this first to orient.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send an SMS/MMS. Provide `body` plus either a `conversationId` or a recipient `to` (E.164); with `to`, the conversation is created from the workspace's active number. With a test-mode API key the send is simulated (recorded, not transmitted).

tools.name: list_numbers
tools.description: List the workspace's phone numbers.

tools.name: search_numbers
tools.description: Search phone numbers available to buy. Filter by type (local, default, or toll_free), country (ISO2, default US), area code prefix (startsWith, e.g. 512 — local only), digits (contains), city (locality) or state. Returns candidates with Ody's monthly price: a local number is included with the plan (

tools.name: buy_number
tools.description: Buy a phone number for the workspace (spends real money — it bills to the workspace's plan like an in-app purchase and appears in the customer's account immediately). Pass an E.164 phoneNumber from search_numbers. The billed type is derived from the number: a local number is included with the plan (

tools.name: get_messaging_status
tools.description: The workspace's 10DLC text-messaging registration status: current step (none → brand → campaign → active), whether outbound texting is unlocked (canText), and any failure reasons.

tools.name: submit_10dlc_registration
tools.description: Submit the workspace's 10DLC registration (brand + campaign) so outbound texting unlocks. Requires the business's legal identity: displayName, email, vertical, street/city/state/postalCode, plus companyName+EIN (or firstName/lastName/phone for SOLE_PROPRIETOR). Billed to the workspace like an in-app

tools.name: place_call
tools.description: Place an outbound phone call handled by the workspace's published AI agent. The agent dials `to` (E.164) from a workspace number, converses, and the call lands on the contact's timeline with credits billed — exactly like an inbound AI-answered call. With a test-mode key the call is simulated.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: One AI agent's config (name, greeting, tone, voice, jobs, hours, publish status, textingEnabled, recordCalls, recordingConsent) plus the workspace's current-cycle credit usage. Without agentId: the primary agent. Use list_agents to see every agent; use get_agent_texting / set_agent_texting / set_age

tools.name: configure_agent
tools.description: Create or update an AI agent (only provided fields change): name, greeting, tone, voice, language, timezone, jobs, inHoursAction/offHoursAction (agent|voicemail|app|forward), enabled. Without agentId this is the primary agent (created on first call); pass agentId to edit another agent (create one wi

tools.name: connect_agent_to_number
tools.description: Route a workspace phone number's inbound calls to an AI agent (voiceMode 'agent'). Default: the primary agent; pass agentId for another. The agent must exist; publish it for live answering. To put a SECOND agent behind a line that already has one, use attach_agent with mode 'menu' instead.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: Every AI agent of the workspace (doc 49) with how callers reach each one — the numbers it answers (`reach.numbers`), the phone-menu keys that lead to it (`reach.menuNumbers`) — plus the plan's agent limit. The first agent (`primary: true`) is what get_agent/configure_agent mean without an agentId.

tools.name: create_agent
tools.description: Add ANOTHER AI agent (e.g. a Spanish line, a sales desk, an after-hours receptionist). Fails when the plan's agent limit is reached (list_agents → limit). Returns a draft — configure it with configure_agent(agentId), give it a line with attach_agent or connect_agent_to_number, then publish.

tools.name: attach_agent
tools.description: Make an agent reachable on one of the workspace's numbers. mode 'number': the line's inbound calls go to this agent. mode 'menu' (the failover for a workspace with ONE line): the line becomes — or extends — a phone menu with a key for this agent, so the previous agent/team keeps key 1 and the new ag

tools.name: delete_agent
tools.description: Delete an AI agent (never the last one). Lines it answered go back to ringing the team; phone-menu keys that led to it are removed. Irreversible.

tools.name: set_agent_recording
tools.description: Turn AI call recording on or off for an agent. When on, every call the agent handles (inbound and outbound) is recorded dual-channel and the audio lands on the call in the thread next to the transcript. Needs the Growth-plan call-recording feature to enable; disabling always works. No publish — appl

tools.name: set_agent_texting
tools.description: Turn Business AI Texting on or off for an agent (the agent-level switch). No publish — replies are written server-side on every inbound text, so the change is immediate. Lines linked to the agent stay linked when you turn it off and resume when you turn it back on; pass unlinkLines:true with enabled

tools.name: set_number_texting
tools.description: Link a workspace number's inbound TEXTS to an AI agent (Business AI Texting), or pass agentId null to unlink. tools.description: Read the workspace's link-tracking settings (Settings → Analytics in the app). tools.name: configure_link_tracking
tools.description: Turn link tracking on or off for the workspace, choose whether clicks show in conversations (showInThread — also bumps the thread to the top of the inbox on the first click, never adds an unread badge), and set the UTM template appended to every destination (utmTemplate; null resets to the default '

tools.name: get_hosted_files
tools.description: Read the workspace's Hosted files settings (Settings → Analytics → Hosted files). On by default: EVERY attachment of a text — one photo, one PDF, a gallery, a video — is delivered as a branded link.ody.co/m/<token> page (business name, logo, accent, Visit-website button — itself a tracked link — Ody

tools.name: configure_hosted_files
tools.description: Change Hosted files settings. Only provided fields change; immediate for the next text sent (pages already sent keep their branding snapshot and keep working). enabled (true = every attachment goes on a page; false = plain picture messages / raw links, nothing tracked), displayName, logoKey (from th

tools.name: set_conversation_ai_texting
tools.description: Business AI Texting hand-off for ONE conversation: paused:true makes the agent stay quiet in this thread (every other thread keeps working) until paused:false hands it back — even if the customer texts again days later. Replying with send_message does NOT pause the agent by itself; pause first when

tools.name: list_conversation_ai_texting_runs
tools.description: What the texting agent did in one conversation — every inbound text it looked at, whether it replied, skipped (and why), or failed. Newest first.

tools.name: wait_for_message
tools.description: Wait (long-poll, up to 25s) for a new inbound message in a conversation. Pass the conversationId and optionally afterActivityId (the last activity you saw — defaults to the newest at call time). Returns the new inbound activities, or timedOut:true when nothing arrived; call again to keep waiting.

tools.name: list_knowledge
tools.description: The workspace's Knowledge hub: folders, articles (title, kind, folder, enabled, audience, size — no bodies) and the AI consumers knowledge can be granted to (each AI agent as `agent:<id>`, plus `replies` for the inbox's AI suggested replies). Use get_knowledge_article for an article's text.

tools.name: get_knowledge_article
tools.description: One knowledge article by articleId, with its full Markdown body, folder, enabled flag and audience.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Find the passages in the workspace's knowledge base that best answer a question (semantic search; full-text while the index builds). Pass consumer (`agent:<id>`, `texting` for AI texting on every number, or `texting:<e164>` for AI texting on one number) to see exactly what that AI knows — audience r

tools.name: create_knowledge_article
tools.description: Write a knowledge article (Markdown, ≤ 20,000 characters) the AI agents answer from: hours, services, pricing, policies, FAQs. Ready at once — no publish step; published agents are updated automatically. Optional folderId; audience defaults to `all` (every AI), or pass audience:`selected` + consumer

tools.name: update_knowledge_article
tools.description: Edit a knowledge article by articleId. Only provided fields change: title, content (replaces the body), folderId (null = top level), enabled (the on/off switch), audience + consumers. Published agents are re-synced.

tools.name: delete_knowledge_article
tools.description: Permanently delete a knowledge article by articleId. Every AI stops using it immediately. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: import_website_knowledge
tools.description: Have Ody read a public website (up to 20 same-site pages) and organize it into one knowledge article the AI agents answer from. Takes 20–40 s. Pass refreshArticleId to re-read an existing website article in place instead of creating a new one. Fails with a reason (blocked | unreachable | no_content)

tools.name: create_knowledge_folder
tools.description: Create a knowledge folder (nest with parentId, up to 3 levels). Set audience:`selected` + consumers to make everything inside readable only by those AIs — e.g. a folder only the sales line's agent reads.

tools.name: update_knowledge_folder
tools.description: Rename or move a knowledge folder, or change its audience (`all` | `selected` + consumers). The audience applies to every article inside. Pass delete:true to delete the folder — its contents move up to the parent folder.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_conversation, search_messages, workspace_summary, get_link_tracking, get_hosted_files, list_knowledge · Private data: list_contacts, create_contact, update_contact, delete_contact, workspace_summary, send_message, place_call, get_hosted_files, configure_hosted_files · Public sink: create_contact, update_contact, send_message, submit_10dlc_registration, get_agent, configure_agent, connect_agent_to_number, create_agent, set_agent_recording, get_agent_texting, set_agent_texting, get_link_tracking, configure_link_tracking, configure_hosted_files, create_knowledge_article · Destructive: delete_contact, delete_agent, delete_knowledge_article, update_knowledge_folder.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_conversation, search_messages, workspace_summary, get_link_tracking, get_hosted_files, list_knowledge · Private data: list_contacts, create_contact, update_contact, delete_contact, workspace_summary, send_message, place_call, get_hosted_files, configure_hosted_files · Public sink: create_contact, update_contact, send_message, submit_10dlc_registration, get_agent, configure_agent, connect_agent_to_number, create_agent, set_agent_recording, get_agent_texting, set_agent_texting, get_link_tracking, configure_link_tracking, configure_hosted_files, create_knowledge_article · Destructive: delete_contact, delete_agent, delete_knowledge_article, update_knowledge_folder

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
